verdict_reason: The two Claude gate bugs and the marked panel fixes are closed, but the new task lock can skip the background's final done write and leave a detached run stuck on running.
reply_markdown:
**Q1. Closed, with one lock hole that is Q2.**

Claude 02, both closed. An unreadable per-file diff now returns `FinishError::Git` (`secret_gate.rs:130-132`) and `git.rs:100-106` aborts before `commit`. A line whose payload starts with `+` survives: `added_from_diff` keeps `rest` after one marker (`secret_gate.rs:175-178`), so `++SECRET` is scanned. Tests at `secret_gate.rs:539` and `:562`.

F03-1 closed. `scan_staged` passes `--diff-filter=ACMRT` (`secret_gate.rs:105-107`) and typechanges go through `staged_blob` (`:143-161`).

F03-2 closed. `git diff --cached --name-only` failure returns `Err` (`secret_gate.rs:114-116`).

F03-3 / F04-2 / F05-5 name half closed. `AGY_READ_ONLY_TOOLS` is an exact `HashSet` (`tree_check.rs:180-191`); `search_replace` is absent (`:212-215`). Empty `tool_name` no longer counts as read-only: the empty string is not in the set, so `agy_tool_is_writing("")` is true (`:193-194`). The denial-retry / continuation snapshot hole is closed by the post-last-turn compare (`orchestrate/mod.rs:4997-5018`): any `initial != after_last` is `failed` before tool names are consulted (`tree.rs:196-199`).

F03-4 / F04-4 / F05-3 closed for the named paths. `compare_collab` returns every content change (`tree_check.rs:163-176`). `engine_tree_outcome` no longer filters; agy with `write_to_file` and a `findings.json`-only delta is `failed` (`tree.rs:200-204`).

F04-6 / F05-8 death-write half closed. `reader_should_record_death` requires a fresh dead pid (`detach.rs:1225-1236`). `ensure_reader_death_record` holds `take_task_lock_at` across re-read and `write_status` (`detach.rs:1281-1295`). `take_task_lock_at` blocks on `WouldBlock` (`store.rs:936-938`). The background `done` path uses the same lock (`detached.rs:534-551`).

F05-1 closed. `NEVER_COMMIT` gained `**/.events-resume-*`, `**/.stderr-resume-*`, `**/.consult.detached-*.prompt.txt`, `**/.consult.detached-*.status.json` (`never_commit.rs:25-36`).

F05-2 closed for both triggers. `diff_is_binary` forces `git cat-file blob` (`secret_gate.rs:143-161`). `scan_message` scans the whole message and `git.rs:175-177` returns `FinishError::MessageSecret`.

F05-4 closed. `ClaudeInit::Unproven` and `ProvenClean` both `failed` on any drift (`tree.rs:184-194`). `claude_init_proof` returns `Unproven` when zero inits were seen (`tree.rs:94-96`). Init parsing is unchanged and still drops a write tool after the 40-name cap (`claude.rs:462-464`); that cap still cannot yield `warned`, because a clean init that wrote is now `failed`.

F05-6 closed. `patch_routing_picked` rewrites `routing.picked` to the reserve (`run.rs:1223-1251`), `render_summary` prefers the re-seat (`:1690-1704`), and exit uses `final_seat_answered` (`:1558-1565`). Re-seats get `base + RESEAT_SEAT_BASE` (`:1136`), so seat `k` does not shadow the lost ledger row.

F05-7 closed. The re-seat keeps `group: seat.group` (`run.rs:717-731`).

F05-9 closed. `endpoint_health_set` walks model marks and clears one only when a newer same-model row is not `model_unsupported` and `is_usable_reply_status` (`health.rs:1169-1205`). A later quota failure does not clear. The verdict if-else is display precedence; persistence no longer uses "newest row wins."

**Q2. Yes — one new hole in the task lock.**

`take_task_lock_at` holds the lock for the whole closure. The background acquires it, calls `finish_status_file` (which calls `write_status`), then `mark_done(exit_code)` (`detached.rs:534-551`). `mark_done` spawns a watchdog and **blocks** on `wait_for_status_quiescence` (`proc.rs:1306-1314`), whose 2s probe loop calls `try_task_lock` (`proc.rs:1394-1416`). The probe always sees `WouldBlock` while the outer closure still holds the lock, so quiescence never observes two quiet probes. After 60s (`proc.rs:98-99`) it proceeds and writes `done` (`detached.rs:547`). During those 60s a status reader can take the same lock (`detach.rs:1281`). If the bridge pid is already dead, `reader_should_record_death` is true (`detach.rs:1233-1236`) and the reader writes `death` over the file (`:1286-1292`), then exits the closure. The blocked `mark_done` then writes `done` and the reader's death does not stick. The missed-write case is the inverse window: the background is inside `wait_for_status_quiescence`, a reader is not required for the bug, and a process kill, crash, or a `write_status` error (`detach.rs:194-197`, surfaced as `warn`) during the post-wait write leaves the file at `running` with no `done`. The reader's next visit then records `death` (`reader_should_record_death` still sees `done` absent). That is a false death for a run whose detach log already contains `exit=<code>`.

No refusal path is unsatisfiable. `scan_message` refuses only on a real `SecretHit` (`secret_gate.rs:83-85`). `MessageSecret` is a third match arm (`mod.rs:65-67`) and exits 2 (`git.rs:175-177`).

The post-last-turn compare does not miss an inter-turn write. `after_last` is a fresh snapshot after the last turn (`orchestrate/mod.rs:4997-5004`). A write between turns is inside `initial != after_last` and forces `failed` (`tree.rs:196-199`). Tool-name aggregation is irrelevant on that path. A write made after `after_last` and before `git status` in `finish_run_tree_check` (`mod.rs:5021-5024`) can still show up as `dirty_files_left` while `tree_check` stays `clean`. That window is the same class as any check that snapshots before a later status, and the checklist below covers it.

**Q3. Both decided boundaries hold. Neither blocks 0.2.4.**

F03-8 / F04-1: a NUL inside the first 8 KiB still skips the blob (`secret_gate.rs:154-157`). `TECH_DEBT.md` states the accepted rule: binary blobs and secrets inside binary are out of scope for 0.2.4. Text secrets and binary-looking text without a NUL are scanned via `git cat-file`.

F04-3: Claude with a proven-clean init that nevertheless changes the tree is now `failed`, not `warned` (`tree.rs:188-191`). The remaining product choice is that Claude has no tool-name gate because the CLI is launched write-disabled; an unproven init fails closed. That matches the decided line "Claude stays usable only when the snapshot is unchanged."

**Not re-filed.** F03-5, F03-6, F03-7, F04-5, F04-7, F05-10 stay open as prior findings. They are outside the commits the coordinator marked fixed. I did not re-verify each call site line-by-line in this pass.

## Requested checks

RC1. Working directory: repo root. Permission: read-only. Budget: 5 minutes. Confirm the lock inversion: read `detached.rs:534-551` against `proc.rs:1306-1416` and check whether any test holds `take_task_lock_at` while calling `mark_done`. Observation that settles finding #1: a test or a scratch detached run whose status mtime stays `running` for ~60s after the engine exits, then flips to `done`, or stays `running` if the process is killed during the wait. A `death` object written in that window must not be the final record if the detach log already says `exit=0`.

findings.claim: The background's final status write holds take_task_lock_at across mark_done, and mark_done waits up to 60s for try_task_lock to succeed. The probe can never see the lock free, because the same closure still owns it. A crash or a failed write during that wait leaves the status file at running with no done object; the next status reader then records death even though the detach log already has exit=<code>. A reader that grabs the lock during the wait can also write death, which mark_done then overwrites with done, so the two writers still race across the timeout.
findings.trigger: A detached c3 consult reaches finish_status_file while its bridge pid is already dead (normal exit, or a kill during wait_for_status_quiescence). Either the post-wait write_status fails or the process dies during the 60s wait, and a later --status/--wait calls ensure_reader_death_record.

evidence.observation: with_lock calls finish_status_file then mark_done(exit_code) inside the take_task_lock_at closure. mark_done's Result is only warned on.

mark_done calls wait_for_status_quiescence before write_status. The wait probes try_task_lock every 2s and returns only after two quiet probes or STATUS_WRITE_SETTLE_TIMEOUT (60s). A held outer lock makes every probe WouldBlock, so the wait always burns the full timeout.

reader_should_record_death is true when the fresh pid check is dead and the re-read status has no done. ensure_reader_death_record then writes death under the same task lock. After the background's timeout it writes done over that death, or, if the background never reaches its write, the death stands for a finished run.
take_task_lock_at blocks until the file lock is acquired and holds it for the entire closure. try_task_lock maps WouldBlock to Ok(None).

findings.verification: Add a unit test that holds take_task_lock_at, calls mark_done on a status file still in phase running, and asserts it returns well under 60s with a done object. On a scratch detached run, kill the process during the settle wait and confirm --status does not record death when the detach log already contains exit=0.
findings.remedy: Do not call mark_done while the task lock is held. Have mark_done assume the caller owns the lock (or split a write_done_locked that skips wait_for_status_quiescence). The outer closure should write the terminal done object itself, then drop the lock. Keep the settle wait only for callers that do not already hold the lock.

first_run_checklist: c3 finish on a staged text file whose added line is `++sk-` plus 32 alphanumerics must exit non-zero with a secret refusal, and the file must stay uncommitted.
c3 finish --message with a secret-shaped token only after the journal title line must exit 2 (MessageSecret) and must not create a commit.
A scratch repo that replaces a committed symlink with a regular file containing `sk-` plus 32 alphanumerics, then c3 finish, must refuse. git diff --cached --name-status must show T for that path.
An agy consult whose tool list contains write_to_file (or search_replace) and whose only collab change is <task>/findings.json must record tree_check.outcome failed and must not exit 0.
A claude consult with an init of only Read, Grep, Glob (or with no init event) that modifies a tracked file must record outcome failed and must not exit 0.

A panel whose non-required seat is refused before start, with a usable reserve, must exit 0, the summary row must name the reserve, and sessions routing.picked must be the reserve. The reserve must not start while another seat of the same endpoint group is still running at the endpoint limit.

After a detached consult exits, .status.json must contain done (not death) within a few seconds of the detach log line exit=0. A concurrent c3 consult --status during shutdown must not be the writer that first creates the terminal object, and it must not leave phase running.
A model-unsupported mark followed by a quota failure for the same model inside 24h must still list that model in models_unsupported.
c3 finish while .collab/<task>/work/01/.events-resume-1.jsonl and .consult.detached-aaaaaaaa.prompt.txt exist must not stage either path (git status after the run shows them untracked or ignored).
